title: Akiyama Mizuki — Reverse Hermit〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I hope Ena made it to class...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to keep seeing you like this, Mizuki, because whatever you're going through is starting to affect me too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you know exactly what I mean.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whenever Kanade or Mafuyu seemed like they needed help, you wanted to be there for them, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's normal to want to help out a friend when they're in need.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm so happy that Ena said that. I really am.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't tell you right now, but when I feel ready... I hope you'll be willing to hear me out...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I actually asked her to wait until I feel ready...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What are you doing here this late? Don't you and your friends have to practice for your show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I let them know that I'd be running late, so it shouldn't be an issue. More importantly, I noticed that you've been at school since this morning.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Were you spying on me with your drone again?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was performing some test flights and its camera just happened to capture you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh really? You know that there are rumors about you spying on the entire school, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Nobody's been harmed by any of those rumors, so I'm giving them no heed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But how long has it been since we last spoke like this? The School Festival?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There was that other time when you made me laugh by showing me that toy you made with recordings of Tsukasa's voice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Mizuki, do you remember that play I told you about when we were still in junior high school...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The play is about a hero patiently waiting for someone...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that. I remember, but only vaguely. People who've seen it are pretty divided over it, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the one.
This play's protagonist never meets whoever they were awaiting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But my wait has come to an end it seems.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You mean Tsukasa and the others?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Until just recently, I kept asking myself whether or not they were who I was waiting for...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm convinced that they are now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My junior-high-school self would be so surprised.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Surprised? You from back then wouldn't believe a word of it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't have to tell me if you really can't right now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean I'm giving up!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to see you with that awful look on your face, and I want to help you in whatever way I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So please, tell me when you feel you're ready. I'll be waiting until then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think I'm making someone wait for me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it's time I got going.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may have a rough road ahead of us in terms of trying to be ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm very glad that you've decided to keep moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And we may not be friends in solitude anymore, but I won't be forgetting the time we shared anytime soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You kept saying how great solitude is...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it seems you've also decided not to leave me be.
